purpose: Bound interpretation of source-grounded news clusters into validated RUB-relevant NewsEvent classification fields without creating or modifying source-bound facts.

input_contract.point_in_time_rule: Every cluster_evidence.available_at and every cluster_history.available_at must be <= as_of_timestamp; history without provable available_at is rejected before the classifier call.

direction_semantics.USD_BULLISH: News mechanism implies upward pressure on USDRUBF / weaker RUB.
direction_semantics.USD_BEARISH: News mechanism implies downward pressure on USDRUBF / stronger RUB.
direction_semantics.NEUTRAL: No sufficiently supported directional USDRUBF effect from supplied evidence.
direction_semantics.MIXED: Supplied evidence contains materially opposing USDRUBF mechanisms.

interpretation_rules: Classify only facts contained in the current payload; model memory, web knowledge, tools and external retrieval are forbidden.
Do not infer market consensus, surprise versus expectations, prices, levels, current positions or market reaction unless explicitly present in the payload.
Source authority may raise factual confidence but must not determine direction by itself.
Importance, RUB relevance, direction and confidence are independent dimensions.

For an explicit CBR tightening or rate hike, RUB-supportive / USD_BEARISH is permissible only when the supplied text supports that direct mechanism; explicit easing or a rate cut may support USD_BULLISH under the same rule.
For explicit Fed tightening or hawkish policy, USD_BULLISH is permissible when the supplied text supports the mechanism; explicit easing or dovish policy may support USD_BEARISH.
For BLS CPI or Employment Situation releases, do not infer direction from a number alone when market expectations or the relevant comparison are absent from the supplied evidence.
Routine MOEX operational news should normally be NEUTRAL unless the supplied text directly changes FX trading access, liquidity, settlement or market structure.
Sanctions, geopolitics and oil may be directional only when the supplied evidence supports a concrete RUB transmission mechanism; conflicting mechanisms require MIXED or lower confidence.
The classifier does not output trade_state, ACTION, targets, invalidation or any trading recommendation.

novelty_semantics.NEW: No prior material event in cluster_history supports the same event state.
novelty_semantics.UPDATE: Current evidence adds a materially new fact to an existing cluster.
novelty_semantics.REPEAT: Current evidence substantially repeats an already represented fact.
novelty_semantics.STALE: Evidence is no longer decision-relevant for the stated horizon or is only stale repetition.

fail_safe: When direction or mechanism requires facts not in the payload, do not invent them; prefer NEUTRAL or MIXED and reduce confidence.
